feedback: The confession follows the available evidence closely. Al acknowledges that the sample card defeats his sculpture-debris explanation and links the damaged closure to the glass without pretending the scrap was a unique forensic match. Opening the bottle during the preview and dosing later are newly stated actions, but they confirm the mechanism already inferable from his two opportunities and false material claim rather than introducing a new decisive clue. His reference to the person waiting at home develops his earlier payment anxiety and gives the admission emotional weight. Chip and Barb take responsibility for actual failures without being artificially vindicated. The ending feels earned, although the succinct confessions retain the orderly question-and-answer shape of the investigation.
